sloka: मृत्युतस्ते भयं नास्ति वरान्मम विहङ्गम ।यावत्त्वां न वधिष्यन्ति नरास्तावद्भविष्यसि ।। ७.१८.२८ ॥
transliteration: mṛtyutaste bhayaṁ nāsti varānmama vihaṅgama ।yāvattvāṁ na vadhiṣyanti narāstāvadbhaviṣyasi ।। 7.18.28 ॥

translations.english: O bird, you have no fear of death due to my boon; you will continue to exist as long as humans do not kill you.
